name: repository-bug-audit
description: Evidence-driven repository-wide bug discovery and engineering risk audit, in unscored Rapid mode or Comprehensive mode with a risk-weighted 0-100 quality score.

interface.shortDescription: Find repository bugs and score engineering risk
interface.longDescription: Audits the whole working tree for material bugs first, then assesses broader engineering quality. Produces one concise Markdown report paired with a machine-readable evidence JSON, validated before delivery. Read-only apart from those two artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use Repository Bug Audit to inspect this whole repository for bugs, ask me to choose Rapid or Comprehensive and Standard or Multi-agent execution, then produce a validated report and evidence JSON.
Run a Comprehensive repository bug and quality audit and give me the 0-100 engineering quality score.
